anticipation.title: The programme director at the console
anticipation.text: The flight team has it now. Your authorised file includes {record}. I am staying to watch this one.

anticipation.title: The ground work goes with them
anticipation.text: I have {record} beside me. This is where that ground work has to hold up. I want to see the first spacecraft checks.

anticipation.title: A final assurance note
anticipation.text: My readiness file records {record}, with its stated limits. I want them to come home. Let the controllers work.

aftermath.title: A moment at the window
aftermath.text: For a moment, I can put the file down. {reference} There is a spacecraft in orbit now. Flight Control has the next checks. I am glad we reached this point.

aftermath.title: The first quiet words
aftermath.text: I wish everyone who worked on those tests could see this view. {reference} I will compare the first spacecraft report when it comes. For now, I am relieved.

aftermath.title: Relief, with the file still open
aftermath.text: There is relief in seeing them reach orbit. {reference} My endorsement still carries its stated limits. Let the controllers do their work.
